senses.gloss: रौचनिक mf(ई)n. (fr. रोचना) coloured with or like (the pigment) Rocanā, yellowish, Kir.
रौचनिक n. the tartar of the teeth, W.
रौच्य m. (fr. रुच्य = बिल्व) a staff of Bilva wood, L.
an ascetic with a staff of B˚ w˚, W.
(fr. रुचि) N. of the 13th (9th) Manu, Hariv.; Pur.
रौच्य mfn. belonging to Manu Raucya, MārkP.
